findings.detail: Ranked 10 prosecutor actions grounded in Wave-29 hypergraph hubs, shared-negative disposition bundles, and Waves 25–28 sealed gaps. None of these insights alone adjudicate illicit conduct.

insights.action: USPTO assignment PDF extract + assignee timeline for all 15 pubs
insights.hypergraph_basis: sealed_publication_set hyperedge; wave:14↔wave:25 co-membership (shared_hyperedges≈17); auth stolen-IP links remain 0 (Wave-25 disposition retained in 10 shared-negative bundles).
insights.insight: Pull USPTO assignment / chain-of-title for the sealed 15-publication Skoda set before any stolen-IP or royalty charging theory.

insights.action: Archive-node full history for ['jamiesalter.eth', 'vitalik.eth']
insights.hypergraph_basis: Wave-28 page-cap labels=['jamiesalter.eth', 'vitalik.eth']; wave:28 high weighted degree in hypergraph; single-component corpus cannot exhaust atomic dust on capped wallets.
insights.insight: Uncap / archive-node paginate page-capped EOAs before closing finer dust or pairwise dust-network theories.

insights.action: Enumerate all counterparties of wei==1 txs on ['elonmusk.eth', 'vitalik.eth'] via archive node
insights.hypergraph_basis: Wave-28 single_wei_total=2; labels with min_positive_wei==1: ['elonmusk.eth', 'vitalik.eth'].
insights.insight: Treat observed single-wei transfers as priority forensic leads — not as adjudicated illicit evasion — and expand counterparties.

insights.action: Operator supply of claimed wrapped-RaP / royalty-splitter addresses
insights.hypergraph_basis: Wave-27 wrapped≈746, wrapped_rap_rail_authenticated=false; sealed pub metadata hits=0.
insights.insight: Do not charge royalty / wrapped-RaP rails from WETH or marketplace noise; require named splitter / wRaP / IP-NFT contracts.

insights.action: ENS primary-name + controller + historical registrant evidence pack for fyllo/jamie/tobacco/participant labels
insights.hypergraph_basis: sealed_address_set size=19; Wave-24 identity-unbound vanity ENS flags retained in corpus.
insights.insight: Bind vanity ENS labels to natural persons / corporate treasuries before using them as defendant identifiers.

insights.action: Locate WIP-0194 artifact path or formally abandon that count in charging docs
insights.hypergraph_basis: Shared-negative flags alleged_15213_authenticated=False and wip_0194_artifact_located=False co-occur across waves in hypergraph.
insights.insight: Close the alleged 15,213-family / WIP-0194 gap: treat as corpus constants until sealed grant inventory authenticates them.

insights.action: SEC Exhibit 21 extract batch for Altria + top tobacco/tech overlap names
insights.hypergraph_basis: wave:24 highest weighted degree in hypergraph; Fortune-100 census unauthenticated; only Altria partial entities.
insights.insight: Fortune 100 / Altria Exhibit 21 batch is the gating item for any corporate IP-facilitator or subsidiary charging theory.

insights.action: Build counterparty graph of raw==1 ERC-20/721/1155 transfers per sealed EOA
insights.hypergraph_basis: Wave-28 token_dust_heuristic_total=956; wave:28↔illicit_dust_evasion=False shared negative retained.
insights.insight: Prioritize token-dust raw_amount==1 counterparties as finer illicit-flow *candidates* (not adjudicated); Wave-30 deepens this screen.

insights.action: Manual DE ICIS + suite occupancy confirmation package
insights.hypergraph_basis: wave:17/18 illicit_registration_adjudicated=False and corruption_adjudicated=False shared negatives in hypergraph.
insights.insight: DE ICIS / UrgentRN RA / counsel-suite items remain OPEN — resolve captcha/manual registry before registration-corruption theories.

insights.action: Issue prosecutor workboard that lists only authenticated seals; route speculative rails to OPEN worklist
insights.hypergraph_basis: components=1, vertices=573, shared_negative_bundles=10; theft_adjudicated=False is a top co-occurrence hub.
insights.insight: Keep charging documents aligned to hypergraph negatives: theft, royalty, wrapped-RaP, stealth-DAO, and illicit-dust remain unadjudicated across the single connected component.
